raw_segments.text: Meanwhile the south wind rose, and with black wings wide hovering all the clouds together
The hills to their supply vapor and exhalation dusk and moist sent up amming, and now the
thickened sky like a dark ceiling stood, down rushed the rain impetuous, and continued till
the earth no more was seen.
The floating vessels swam uplifted and secure with beaked prow road tilting o'er the waves,
all dwellings else flood overwhelmed, and them with all their pomp deep under water
Sea covered sea, sea without shore, and in their palaces where luxury late reigned, sea
monsters whelped and stabled, of mankind so numerous late all left in one small bottom
